Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

depend verb

be decided by

also depend on, it depends, that depends, depending on, be up to, hinge on, rest on, it depends a lot on whether

classical

Cic. Parad. 2.17: pendet ex fortūnā
Cic. de Or. 2.107: ex quō verbō … tōta illa causa pendēbat

pendeō, pendēre, pependī

verb, second conjugation: with ex and the ablative

depend on (literally, hang from)

What a thing depends on goes in ex with the ablative; Lewis & Short also give in, ab, dē or the plain ablative. Of people: tuōrum, quī ex tē pendent, your family, who depend on you (Cic. Fam. 6.22.2).

Other words

  • in aliquō positum esse — depend on someone, be up to someone

    phrase: in with the ablative; positum agrees with what depends · also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 9.25.3: id ille in tē positum esse putat; Traupman 96: tōtum in tē positum est, it all depends on you; Traupman 303

    Also of the self: ut omnia tua in tē posita esse dūcās, that you think everything that is yours depends on yourself (Cic. Lael. 7).

  • interest — it depends (who, what, how, whether …); it makes a difference

    impersonal verb (from intersum): with an indirect question · also used · classical · Plin. Ep. 6.24.1: Quam multum interest quid ā quōque fīat!; Cic. Fam. 13.10.4: interest quālis prīmus aditus sit

    “It depends” is a construction of its own: interest or rēfert, it matters, with an indirect question, its verb in the subjunctive. Traupman (p. 96) gives plūrimum rēfert num …, it depends a lot on whether …. That it makes no difference is nihil interest, nīl rēfert (see it makes no difference).

  • prout — depending on, according as

    conjunction, with the indicative · also used · classical · Liv. 38.40.14: prout animus pugnantium est

Examples

  • cui spēs omnis et ratiō et cōgitātiō pendet ex fortūnā, huic nihil potest esse certī

    a man whose every hope, plan and thought depends on fortune can be sure of nothingCic. Parad. 2.17

  • id ille in tē positum esse putat mihique persuādet

    he thinks it depends on you, and he has convinced meCic. Fam. 9.25.3

  • Quam multum interest quid ā quōque fīat!

    How much depends on who does a thing!Plin. Ep. 6.24.1

  • sīc ignis nōn rēfert quam magnus sed quō incidat

    so with a fire, it depends not on how big it is but on where it fallsSen. Ep. 18.15

  • prout locus inīquus aequusve hīs aut illīs, prout animus pugnantium est, prout numerus …, varia fortūna pugnae est

    depending on whether the ground favoured one side or the other, on the fighters’ spirit and on their numbers, the fortune of the fight variedLiv. 38.40.14

  • Plūrimum rēfert num …

    It depends a lot on whether …Traupman 303

See also depend, it makes no difference, concern, cause.
